name: inbox-triage
description: Reads your recent inbox (last 2 days by default, 1 to 14 if you ask) and sorts each thread into urgent (needs you today), reply (someone is waiting on you, not today-critical) and ignore (bulk, automated, FYI), each with a one-line reason that quotes the email. Clear cases are decided by rules in code (bulk senders, receipts, payment failures, deadlines today, your VIPs); only the ambiguous rest goes to the model, and an urgent call it can't back with a quote is demoted. Up to 60 threads per turn, with "continue" for older ones. Read-only: it never sends, archives, labels, deletes, marks read or drafts replies.

skills.name: Inbox triage
skills.description: Your recent inbox threads sorted into urgent, reply and ignore, each with a quoted reason, counts per bucket and the top 3 to do first. Window 2 days by default (1-14), VIP senders from your message, read-only.
